chief_complaint: Routine follow-up for type 2 diabetes mellitus with chronic kidney disease and hypertension
history_of_present_illness: The patient is a 53‑year‑old male with a long‑standing history of obesity (onset 2014) leading to prediabetes in 1990 and progression to type 2 diabetes in 2016. Metabolic syndrome and hypertriglyceridemia were diagnosed in 2018. Diabetic kidney involvement was first recorded in 2019 (CKD stage 1, disorder of kidney due to diabetes) and progressed to CKD stage 2 with microalbuminuria by early 2020. Blood pressure shows isolated diastolic hypertension (95 mmHg) classified as stage 2. Anemia has been present since 1996. The only documented medication is insulin (Humulin) for glucose control; no antihypertensive, lipid‑lowering, or renoprotective agents are recorded. Socially, the patient reports ongoing intimate‑partner abuse, a criminal record, and full‑time employment. Recent visits have been primarily wellness visits, with the last encounter in April 2021.
